newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Lower beef prices Friday and live trade seen slow but expectations beef may firm soon could support market.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. CME index unchanged and corn futures called lower.
LIVE HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Mostly lower live calls and technically very weak after limit loss Friday.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.100 to 0.400 cent. Technically weak after losses Friday. Slaughter larger than expected .
